lena.design: Quick design ping New ephemeral toast for job completion on dark console. Mock attached. Needs: SR announcement, keyboard flow, contrast checks, copy. Short CTA: "Open results". isa.a11y: Thanks! A couple quick rules: if it's actionable we should either move focus into the toast or ensure an accessible name + visible focus on a control. Relying solely on aria-live for actionables is flaky. josh.frontend: Our intent was minimal disruption it appears after user clicks run. Plan: show toast, auto-close in 8s, user can press Esc or click Close. If user clicks Run, auto-focus is acceptable? isa.a11y: If user initiated the run then yes, moving focus is OK. Save the triggering element and restore focus when toast closes. Also set aria-atomic and add a short SR-only prefix like "Notification:". rahul.eng: Implementation detail: we'll keep toast container tabindex=-1 and focus the first button inside. Avoid focus traps, Tab should move out after the toast controls. josh.frontend: Proposed markup (snippet): ```html
Notification: Job complete Summarizer v2
Summarizer v2: Result ready
``` josh.frontend: Focus flow: const trigger = document.activeElement; toast.querySelector('.toast-open').focus(); onClose -> trigger && trigger.focus(); isa.a11y: Contrast: current mock uses bg #121214 and copy #e3e3e3 (~4.1:1). Need >=4.5:1 for body text. Suggest #fafafa for body text or darken bg to #0f0f11. Buttons need clear focus styles with >=3:1 on the ring color. lena.design: Good catch. I'll update the mock to #fafafa for copy and adjust CTA color to maintain brand accent. Keep animation short (150-200ms) and respect prefers-reduced-motion. josh.frontend: Keyboard discoverability: we have a header skiplink "Skip to content" and "Skip to notifications". Make skiplinks visible on focus (not only on hover). If toast is visible, pressing the notifications skiplink should land in the notifications area; we should not hijack that flow. isa.a11y: Correct. Only auto-focus the toast when user action triggers it (like Run). If toast appears spontaneously from background sync, don't auto-focus. Also ensure Esc closes and returns focus as discussed. jia.pm: Copy suggestion: instead of "Job complete" use contextual copy: "Result ready Summarizer v2" and CTA "Open results". Keep it under 40 chars. Also SR hint: "Press Enter to open" as sr-only text. rahul.eng: We'll add keydown handler scoped to the toast when it's focused so Enter activates the primary action. No global key binding. josh.frontend: Tests: unit test for focus restore, accessibility test asserting aria-live text exists, and contrast test via axe. Add a simple e2e sim where keyboard user runs job, toast appears, focuses CTA, tabs out, and on close focus restores. isa.a11y: Also ensure aria-role: use role="status" for polite, role="alert" only if immediate. aria-live polite plus focus to control is good. And add aria-live only as a backup; the interactive control is the main affordance. lena.design: Thanks all. I'll update the Figma with color #fafafa and add a visible-on-focus skiplink state. Sam @josh please send PR when ready and tag me + isa. Keeping thread open until merged. :sparkles:
